messages:
maya: Noticed a cluster-wide uptick in Xid 31 and Xid 13 starting ~02:45 UTC in us-west2. Mostly on A10 nodes in rack-12/rack-13.

josh: Same here, payloads were heavy decode workloads and some long chat sessions.

li: Query from metrics — these nodes show concurrent decode qps bump + memory ECC warnings. Quick snippet: 
```
GPU0: Xid=31 (CECC) count=12 since 02:40
GPU1: Xid=13 (illegal instruction) spike at 02:47
nvml: ecc_corrected=42 ecc_uncorrected=1
```

nina: @maya can you post the tenant ops? Is this concentrated on one customer or spread?

maya: Spread across ~6 tenants, but two high-decode tenants (tenant-alpha, tenant-zeta) account for ~60% of affected requests.

sam: ops-bot pulled GPU telemetry, attaching stack-level heatmap — Xid31s correlate with sustained sequence lengths >1200 and batch sizes >8.

infra-bot: [automated] Relevant alert: "gpu.ecc.corrected.threshold_exceeded" fired 02:46 on rack-12-group.

josh: Hypothesis: long KV cache + continuous attention causing memory bit flips under sustained load. Could be hardware thermal or microcode.

li: We should test isolating workload type. Can we route decode-heavy traffic off A10s to other pools for 30m and observe?

maya: I can carve a routing policy to steer tenant-zeta to us-west2-burst (V100) and reduce batch targets for tenant-alpha. Will roll in 10m.

nina: Do we have driver/kernel updates pending? Last A10 firmware update was 2024-11.

sam: No queued kernel upgrades for prod racks yet. We've seen a handful of NV driver patches in internal changelog (secfix-2025-01) but not rolled.

li: For triage: 3-pronged plan — 1) isolate by routing, 2) lower batch/seq for affected tenants, 3) mark suspicious cards as soft-drain and run vendor diagnostics.

maya: Started routing change at 02:58. Reducing max_batch from 12->6 for the two tenants.

josh: After routing, Xid31 rate dropped ~70% on A10s in rack-12. However Xid13 persists at low level on GPU1/GPU3.

li: Xid13 is often illegal instruction / firmware mismatch — need core dump from one of the cards. Can someone schedule an ssh + nvidia-smi dmon collection on GPU3?

sam: I ran `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,utilization.gpu,memory.total,memory.used,driver_version --format=csv -l 1` and attached CSV to the internal ticket.

infra-bot: [automated] Created ticket INF-3412: "A10 rack-12 intermittent Xid13 + Xid31 during decode workloads" assigned to eng-infra oncall.

nina: Recommend we soft-drain GPU3 for a maintenance window so vendor diag can run. If it's flaky, replace before next commit.

maya: Soft-drain started on GPU3 at 03:12. OOMs on queue decreased and latency normalized for affected tenants.

josh: Cost note — routing to V100 burst increased token unit cost by ~2.8x during 30m window. Finance FYI: could matter if long-term.

li: For longer-term: consider scheduling heavy decode batches on cards with ECC history cleared and keep embedder workloads on lower-memory footprints. Also enable periodic ECC scrubbing for susceptible nodes.

nina: Agreed. Also let's add a telemetry flag to correlate Xid counts with op_type (decode/chat/embeddings) at 1m granularity. Current logs tie to tenant but not op subtype.

maya: Filed feature request: DEVEX-1299 to add op_type tagging in the request trace.

sam: After soft-drain and routing, residual Xid13s only on retired GPU3. Diagnostics show degraded ECC counters + microcontroller timeouts. Vendor asked to run `nvidia-smi diag --run` in maintenance.

josh: If vendor confirms microcontroller instability, plan to replace card under RMA.

li: One more ask — add an automated rollback policy in routing so if latency improves we revert within 10m to avoid cost drift.

maya: Implemented a canary rollback watch: if p50 latency remains < baseline+10% for 10m, revert routing.

nina: Thanks. Postmortem checklist: collect nv-host logs, ECC counters, op_type correlation, tenant impact matrix, cost delta during reroute.

infra-bot: [automated] Postmortem checklist item created: PM-564.

sam: I'll coordinate with vendor for RMA tomorrow and schedule diag window.

maya: Closing loop — Xid31 incidents down to baseline after measures. Leaving GPU3 soft-drained pending vendor.

josh: Good job. Follow-up items assigned in INF-3412. :thumbsup:
